title: Token approvals & allowances management is flawed
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** Medium, because it will be problematic only with special type of tokens  **Impact:** Medium, because it can lead to a limited loss of funds  ## Description  There are a few problems related to approvals & allowances in the contract. One is that the `swaptoGLP` method approves another contract to spend tokens, but some tokens (like `USDT`) have approval race condition protection, which requires the allowance before a call to `approve` to already be either 0 or `UINT_MAX`. If this is not the case, the call reverts, which can lead to a DoS situation with `swaptoGLP`.
